core_meaning.primary_meaning: Safeena is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Ship, vessel”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Safeena corresponds to the Arabic form سَفِينَة (Arabic root س ف ن (s-f-n); سَفِينَة (Safīna)). Its core sense is safeena; ship, vessel.
